name: Reversible Denoising Lifting Scheme DWT
aliases: Reversible Denoising Lifting Scheme DWT — RDLS-DWT
Reversible Denoising and Lifting Steps (RDLS) with Step Skipping
definition: A wavelet transform variant that replaces the standard prediction and update lifting steps with Reversible Denoising Lifting Steps (RDLS) to prevent noise propagation between subbands while maintaining perfect reversibility.
summary: Reversible Denoising Lifting Scheme DWT is a wavelet transform variant that integrates denoising-aware lifting steps to prevent noise propagation while maintaining perfect reversibility.
